description: This file contains functions to create and load different variants of the DETR model for object detection and segmentation, including configurations with different backbones, dilation options, pretrained weights, and panoptic segmentation. It also provides specific factory functions for these variants.

methods.name: _make_detr(backbone_name: str, dilation=False, num_classes=91, mask=False)
methods.description: Factory function to construct a DETR model with specified backbone, dilation, and number of classes; optionally wraps in segmentation if mask=True.

methods.name: detr_resnet50(pretrained=False, num_classes=91, return_postprocessor=False)
methods.description: Creates a DETR ResNet-50 model, optionally loads pretrained weights, and can return a postprocessing module.

methods.name: detr_resnet50_dc5(pretrained=False, num_classes=91, return_postprocessor=False)
methods.description: Creates a dilated ResNet-50 DETR model with pretrained options and optional postprocessing.

methods.name: detr_resnet101(pretrained=False, num_classes=91, return_postprocessor=False)
methods.description: Creates a ResNet-101 DETR model, optionally loads pretrained weights, with optional postprocessing.

methods.name: detr_resnet101_dc5(pretrained=False, num_classes=91, return_postprocessor=False)
methods.description: Creates a dilated ResNet-101 DETR model with pretrained weights and optional postprocessing.

methods.name: detr_resnet50_panoptic( pretrained=False, num_classes=250, threshold=0.85, return_postprocessor=False )
methods.description: Creates a panoptic segmentation DETR model based on ResNet-50, with confidence thresholding, optionally pretrained, and returns postprocessing if requested.

methods.name: detr_resnet50_dc5_panoptic( pretrained=False, num_classes=250, threshold=0.85, return_postprocessor=False )
methods.description: Creates a dilated ResNet-50 panoptic DETR model, similar to above.

methods.name: detr_resnet101_panoptic( pretrained=False, num_classes=250, threshold=0.85, return_postprocessor=False )
methods.description: Creates a panoptic DETR model based on ResNet-101.
